capabilities: Search notes by combining keyword matching with meaning
Group vault notes into topics in a Smart Graph
Chat with an agent that reads and writes notes
Render charts and dashboards as live widgets from note data
Connect AI providers such as Ollama, OpenAI, and Anthropic
disambiguation: Not a personal knowledge management method or note organization system; it is an AI assistant plus semantic search layer over the vault.
extras: Full setup guides and documentation live on smartsecondbrain.dev, not in the README. The README states no telemetry, notes only leave the machine for configured providers, and a daily update check fetching the manifest from GitHub that can be disabled in settings.
intentEvidence: better search, an interactive knowledge graph, and an AI assistant that actually knows your notes
problem: Obsidian's search matches keywords only, the core graph shows links without grouping by topic, and no built-in assistant can read and act on your notes.
